Warm brown clean thin outlines, large legible muted pastel color shapes, cream, soft sage, dusty blue, coral and lavender. Matte flat fills with ONE restrained shadow tone, minimal texture. Asset type: registered character animation sheet. Reference 1 sets the current smooth simple chicken design; reference 2 only preserves this resident's outfit/identity. One SAME cream egg-shaped friendly chicken in every cell, modest red comb, tiny orange beak, rosy cheeks, dark simple eyes, short complete orange feet, feather wings, NO human hands. Outfit: a sage-green postal cap with small round brass badge, dusty-blue button vest and small brown cross-body mail satchel. Same height, proportions, outfit, scale and baseline across every frame. Slight right-facing three-quarter front for idle, side walk and job.
Exactly FIVE columns and TWO rows, ten equally spaced cells on a wide landscape canvas. COLUMN 1 idle top/bottom: both feet planted, empty relaxed wings, tiny breathing change. COLUMN 2 WALK RIGHT: TOP lifts and advances the screen-right foot with screen-left foot planted; BOTTOM lifts and advances screen-left foot with screen-right foot planted. The TWO OPPOSITE feet visibly alternate, not the same foot twice. COLUMN 3 WALK NORTH: true REAR VIEW, back of head/clothes/tail, NO EYES OR BEAK; top left foot lifted, bottom right foot lifted. COLUMN 4 WALK SOUTH: FRONT VIEW with both eyes visible; top left foot lifted, bottom right foot lifted. COLUMN 5 job top/bottom: inspect and offer ONE cream envelope with coral wax seal, top holding it at chest height, bottom extending it forward slightly.
Each figure occupies at most 70 percent of cell width and height; clear transparent gutters, complete body and feet inside every cell. No drawn grid, labels, scenery, furniture, extra characters, duplicate props or foot shadows. Walking changes the legs while keeping head/body size stable. Rear views must have no face. These cells will be mechanically cropped without repainting.
